newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss purchasing managers' index rises in February.
newsitem.headline: Swiss purchasing managers' index rises in February.

text.p: The Swiss Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 53.8 percent in February, the second time in a row that it has pointed to an expansion in Swiss industry.
The rise in the index from January's revised 51.3 percent, was due to a significant increase in orders, longer delivery times and only a slight drop in employment levels.

Apart from the sub-index for production, all sub-indicies in the PMI rose considerably in February, said a joint statement from Credit Suisse and the Swiss Association for Material Management and Purchasing (SVME), which compile the index.
The PMI, published since September 1995, is based on surveys in which companies are asked to rate each sub-index as higher, lower or unchanged from the month before.
